attributes.board_name: Junta Examinadora de Consejeros Profesionales de Puerto Rico (Departamento de Salud)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education in the areas set by Ley 147-2002 Art. 8(f) and Reglamento 7521; no limit on modules, journals or internet courses (Res. 2024-43).

topics.who: Course "Equidad y Respeto": bioethics and discrimination in all legally recognized forms (from 2024, Orden Adm. 2024-583; Res. 2024-43)

rules.legal_basis: Ley Núm. 147-2002, Art. 11 (20 L.P.R.A. § 3250); Reglamento 7521 (Educación Continua)
rules.notes: License renewed every 3 years with evidence of 45 CE hours. Renewal also requires ASUME certification and criminal record certificates (under 30 days). Renew about 90 days before expiry. Reglamento 7521 is a scanned PDF (not text-read).
